title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Service Agent in Microsoft 365 as a dedicated service specialist
summary: Hold: Microsoft already documents preview licensing requirements and Copilot Credit charges for Service Agent, so the unpublished-licensing statements and low cost rating would mislead budget owners. Its agent account and required security, audit and cost-management controls are also documented. The roadmap dates and the cited general blocking controls check out.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing and user prerequisites for this agent are not yet published, so the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Sales Development Agent and Service Agent: The person responsible for the agent (that is, the accountable user to whom the agent is assigned) is required to have consumption billing enabled.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'consumption'. Replace the unpublished-licensing assertions with: 'For Public Preview, Frontier enrollment is required; the tenant must have at least one Microsoft 365 Copilot or E7 license, and the accountable user responsible for Service Agent must have consumption billing enabled. Additional requirements may apply for General Availability.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-resources-for-agents and make the summary, Scope and licensing notes agree.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing, first paragraph; rationale: cost

The agent account, email address and persistent Microsoft 365 resource access cost 100 Copilot Credits per agent per month; agent activity is billed consumptively in addition. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/office-365-platform-service-description/microsoft-365-resources-for-agents.
